title: Crane Lake New Residence
description: Wenjun Zhong explored Crane Lake New Residence, a 200-year-old Hakka architectural marvel in Shenzhen. Witness its symbolic fusion of ancestral traditions and modernity, reflecting Hakka resilience and cultural evolution. From moon pools to grey-tiled walls, this "living fossil" embodies identity, migration, and the enduring quest to preserve roots amid urbanization. A journey through time and belonging.
